description: The boolean-conversion intrinsic pair FUNCTION BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER (ISO 15.13) / INTEGER-OF-BOOLEAN (15.45). LIVE (P11 Step 2): BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER returns a boolean value of argument-2 positions - rightmost position = low-order binary digit, zero-filled or TRUNCATED ON THE LEFT (the result is arg-1 mod 2^arg-2, Annex D.10's 544->low-6-bits worked example) - a boolean function result IS class/category boolean with implicit usage bit (15.2 item 2); INTEGER-OF-BOOLEAN returns the unsigned MSB-first value of the whole bit configuration (15.45.4 r1). Both are 2002 introductions (the boolean-data amendment); below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502).
citation: ISO §2023:15.13 BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER / §2023:15.45 INTEGER-OF-BOOLEAN; §2023:15.2 item 2 (result category Boolean)
vcr: M2 catalog boolean intrinsics; 2002 introduction (the boolean-data amendment - derive from the 2002 standard; absent from the 1989 Intrinsic Function Module set)
